findings.title: Reject symlinks before writing evidence into an untrusted worktree
findings.trigger: An outside-contributor head contains .codex-review-evidence/pytest.txt as a symlink to an existing writable file outside the checkout, and the operator reviews it with --untrusted.
findings.execution_path: execute creates the detached worktree, then _run_pytest takes the untrusted branch and calls _publish_evidence. Path.write_text follows the checked-out symlink and truncates its target before Codex starts.
findings.consequence: An untrusted contribution can overwrite an operator-accessible file with the evidence text despite tests being disabled and Codex using a read-only sandbox. The host-side write occurs outside that sandbox.
findings.evidence: _publish_evidence creates the parent with exist_ok=True and writes to the fixed path without checking either the parent or destination for symlinks. _run_pytest explicitly calls it for untrusted heads at lines 284–285. Existing untrusted-source tests use an empty fake worktree and only verify that uv was not called, so they do not protect this boundary.
findings.suggested_fix: Reserve a fresh evidence directory that cannot be supplied by the reviewed tree, or reject pre-existing evidence paths and symlink components before writing. Use exclusive, no-follow file creation and add regressions for both a symlinked directory and a symlinked pytest.txt, asserting that external sentinel files remain unchanged.
findings.hypothesis: On a filesystem preserving Git symlinks, a committed pytest.txt symlink to a writable external sentinel will cause _publish_evidence to overwrite that sentinel. The execution path was traced statically; an overwrite reproduction was not attempted under the read-only restriction.

limitations: Did not independently rerun the full pytest suite because it requires filesystem writes. Harness evidence reports 2,383 passed and 38 warnings on the exact head.
The first focused pytest invocation failed during temporary-file capture setup. Retrying with capture and plugin autoload disabled passed 30 tests; another 93 pure checker tests passed.
Did not execute the symlink overwrite reproduction, live Codex orchestration, browser checks or hosted acceptance flows.
External BM installation and historical approval claims were reviewed as repository documentation, not independently verified outside this working copy.
